key_points: Morgan Stanley (MS) shares down ~8.8% over 8 consecutive trading days, driven by technical selling pressure rather than fundamental news
Dallas Hub real estate investment noted but viewed as already priced in; no earnings, guidance, or regulatory catalysts identified
Multiple headlines conflate MS (Morgan Stanley) with MSFT (Microsoft) — Microsoft's AI-driven rally is irrelevant to MS thesis
Technical indicators suggest oversold bounce possible, but no fundamental catalyst to sustain reversal
MS INTERNATIONAL (MSI.L) is a separate UK entity; unrelated to NYSE:MS
